title: Flux Video Upscale
description: Upscale videos to 1080p, 2K, or 4K via API. FLUX 3 powered super-resolution with a precise mode and a creative detail-enhancement mode.

pricing.text: Billing is calculated per second of output video, by resolution and mode. In precise mode, 1080p costs $0.14 per second, 2K costs $0.25 per second, and 4K costs $0.55 per second. Creative mode costs more at each tier: $0.20, $0.35, and $0.79 per second respectively. A 10-second 1080p clip runs $1.40 in precise mode or $2.00 in creative mode. You are charged for the delivered output only.

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: URL of the MP4 video to upscale. The video must be at most 20 seconds and 50 MB.

inputs.name: upscale_factor
inputs.tooltip: Output scaling factor. The source aspect ratio is preserved.

inputs.name: creativity
inputs.tooltip: Use 0 for a source-faithful upscale or 1 for creative detail enhancement.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Optional description used to guide creative detail enhancement. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: Moderation strictness. Lower values are stricter.
